title: Sumo Slam
description: Two very round wrestlers, one ring that keeps shrinking. Barge, dash and shove until someone goes over the edge. A chili makes you quick, a donut makes you heavy. Best of five, against the CPU or a friend.
instructions: Player 1: WASD to move, Space to dash. Player 2: arrow keys to move, Enter to dash. On a phone, left thumb moves and tapping the right side dashes.
